summary: Phase 5 delivers a zero-patch mirror of the Superpowers fork with all four intents (SP-1, SP-2, SP-3, SP-4a) expressed in a fenced AAW-owned routing block. The block is host-neutral, manifest-gated, and installed idempotently into both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Behaviour proofs (ACC-04, ACC-05) passed on round 6 after catching two real defects (F1: contradictory routing rules; F2: missing precedence claim over skill defaults). Cross-model review by codex and opencode returned unanimous PASS WITH FINDINGS, both recommending pure mirror publication. The idempotency suite was strengthened with 13 new checks and mutant-verified. MODEL: Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8. Three minor findings remain: (1) behavioural evidence covers opencode harness only, (2) original fixtures had instruction files placed by controller (addressed in re-prove), (3) AskUserQuestion naming without explicit equivalents (declined with reason). The human gate resolved all major findings; publishing the mirror requires force-push authorization outside this session's scope.
